npc_thorne->pc_main.subject: npc_thorne
npc_thorne->pc_main.opinion: Watched her grow up behind his bar. Trusts her hands and not her curiosity. Would rather she left the ledger alone and cannot say so without saying why.

history.reason: Twenty years of her sitting at the end of his bar

npc_mira->pc_main.subject: npc_mira
npc_mira->pc_main.opinion: A useful pair of hands who can read. Has not yet decided whether Vessa is a colleague or a tool.

history.reason: Hired her this morning on the strength of her handwriting

npc_garret->pc_main.subject: npc_garret
npc_garret->pc_main.opinion: Has orders about her specifically and is not proud of it. Expects her to try the stair and hopes she does it while he is looking the other way.

history.reason: The Ashen Hand named her when they posted him here

pc_main->npc_thorne.subject: pc_main
pc_main->npc_thorne.opinion: The closest thing to family she has left, and the reason she has never once looked at the last page of that ledger.
